name: dacantour
description: Dacan Tour — Kyrgyzstan & US trips website (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend

//optionalDependencies: npm records only the host platform's optional binaries in the lockfile (npm/cli#4828), so a lock generated on macOS leaves Linux CI without rollup's native module and Vitest won't start. Declaring it directly forces it into the lock; npm skips it on non-Linux machines via the package's own os/cpu constraints.
//overrides: Pin ONE React across the workspace. Test libs accept React 18 or 19 as a peer, and npm will happily hoist 19 next to the app's 18 — which breaks rendering with 'A React Element from an older version of React was rendered'.
